name: Proud Lion
description: Posing to a wild crowd after kills gives allies a damage and speed boost
details: Damage: +40%.
Movement speed: +20%.
Duration: 10 seconds.
Applies to you and all allies.
Trigger: Pose after kills while your crowd is wild.

name: Regal Lion
description: Posing to a wild crowd after kills makes them throw  [Coin]
details: Each successful pose adds 2 coins to your crowd-money queue.
The queue is metered using a 10-second boost timer; a small queue can empty sooner.

name: Hoarding Lion
description: Posing to a wild crowd after kills makes them throw weapons
details: One weapon-assistance request per successful pose.
The weapon is chosen randomly.

name: Lethal Eagle
description: Powerful throw after melee kills
details: Next throw: double direct-impact damage.
Ready window: 8 seconds after a melee kill.
Consumed when the projectile launches, even if it misses.
The bonus is not established for explosion damage.

name: Silent Eagle
description: Powerful throw after backstabs
details: Next throw: double direct-impact damage.
Ready window: 8 seconds after a backstab.
Consumed when the projectile launches, even if it misses.
Explosion damage has no confirmed bonus from this effect.

name: Patient Eagle
description: Powerful throw after blocking
details: Next throw: double direct-impact damage.
Ready window: 8 seconds after a successful block.
Consumed when the projectile launches, even if it misses.
Explosion damage has no confirmed bonus from this effect.

name: Hulking Bear
description: More health, less movement speed. Brief invulnerability and fury on taking damage
details: Base health: +25% (60 becomes 75 before other modifiers).
Movement speed: -20%.
Taking damage grants 1.75 seconds of invulnerability and base Fury.
Fury duration bonuses can extend the Fury.

name: Mighty Bear
description: More health, less movement speed. Attacks with blunt weapons deal 20% more damage and briefly stun
details: Base health: +25% (60 becomes 75 before other modifiers).
Movement speed: -20%.
Blunt weapons: +20% damage.
Blunt melee hits: minimum 0.3-second base stun.
Longer existing stuns are preserved; other stun modifiers still apply.

name: Vengeful Bear
description: More health, less movement speed. Upon dying, revive with 10% health and permanent fury
details: Base health: +25% (60 becomes 75 before other modifiers).
Movement speed: -20%.
The revival restores 10% health and grants permanent Fury.

name: Deadly Panther
description: More damage, less health. +50% special attack damage
details: Attack damage: +25%.
Base health: -25% (60 becomes 45 before other modifiers).
Special attacks multiply damage by another 1.5x.

name: Pouncing Panther
description: More damage, less health. Dodge becomes a tripping Pounce
details: Attack damage: +25%.
Base health: -25% (60 becomes 45 before other modifiers).
Base pounce duration: 0.55 seconds (ordinary roll: 0.75 seconds).

name: Unrelenting Panther
description: More damage, less health. Consecutive hits on one enemy increases damage
details: Attack damage: +25%.
Base health: -25% (60 becomes 45 before other modifiers).
Repeat-hit bonus: +12.5% per consecutive hit after the first, up to +50%.
Changing targets resets this bonus.

name: Ferocious Wolf
description: More dismemberments. Deal +200% damage with enemy body parts
details: Eligible fatal hits can receive an extra dismemberment roll, up to 20%.
The extra chance decreases in later waves; normal dismemberment rules still apply.
Enemy body-part attack damage: x3 (+200%).

name: Bone Collector Wolf
description: More dismemberments. Earn  [Coin]  when picking up body parts
details: Body-part pickup: +4 coins.
Eligible fatal hits can receive an extra dismemberment roll, up to 20%.
The extra chance decreases in later waves; normal dismemberment rules still apply.

name: Ravenous Wolf
description: More dismemberments. Heal yourself when picking up body parts
details: Body-part pickup heals 3% of maximum health, rounded up.
For example, 60 maximum health gives 2 HP. Healing is capped at your health limit.
Eligible fatal hits can receive an extra dismemberment roll, up to 20%.
The extra chance decreases in later waves; normal dismemberment rules still apply.

name: Agile Ibex
description: Faster movement. Dodges cost 50% less stamina
details: Base movement speed: +20%.
Dodge stamina cost: x0.5 before other modifiers.

name: Desperate Ibex
description: Faster movement. Permanent vigor when less than 25% health
details: Base movement speed: +20%.
Low-health Vigor adds +40% movement and an extra 6 stamina/second.
These movement multipliers combine: 1.2 x 1.4 = 1.68x before other modifiers.

name: Binding Ibex
description: Faster movement, longer chains. Chain trips and squeezes do extra damage
details: Base movement speed: +20%.
Chain length: +25% per Stag III end; two such ends give +56.25%.
Chain trip/squeeze: +5 base damage per Stag III end.
Day scaling and damage modifiers still apply.

name: Armoured Rhino
description: Shields last twice as long. 25% less damage taken

name: Stomping Rhino
description: Shields last twice as long. Stun duration +50%

name: Reckless Rhino
description: Shields last twice as long. Shield Throw (block + throw)
details: Shield projectile base impact damage: 12.
Base trip duration: 2.5 seconds, plus 1 second against enemies.
These are projectile base values; throw charge and combat modifiers affect the result.

name: Clever Monkey
description: Reroll Trainer skills. Start with 2 Skills and an  [Skull2]  affliction

name: Vicious Monkey
description: Reroll Trainer skills. +50% unarmed damage. Unarmed special sends enemies flying
details: Unarmed damage: +50%.
The special launches eligible enemies with a 0.6-second toss duration.
Blocked or immune targets can prevent the launch; travel distance depends on the toss.

name: Curious Monkey
description: Reroll Trainer skills. Only one skill choice, but earn a bonus skill every third level
